pages.text: Craft this guide before you leave the Overworld. Then make a $(thing)Scarab$() and gather $(thing)49 sandstone blocks$() to $(l:atum:expedition/portal)build the smallest portal$(/l). Pack food, a water bucket, torches, a pickaxe, a shield, and spare blocks.
Craft the field guide with a book and sandstone in any arrangement.
Three gold ingots and a diamond make the portal Scarab.
